# Data curation 

## Read and curate the image prediction data
```{r}
file_predictions <- "C:/Users/patri/python_workspace/copepods-lipid-content/prediction_outputs/model_resnet34_prosomeUVP6_amund2024_test/new_predictions_uvp6_20250730.csv"

amund2024_pred <- read.csv(file_predictions) %>% 
  filter(prosome_pixels_predicted > 0,
         lipidpcrop_pixels_predicted > 0,
         lipidfullness2 > 20) %>% 
  mutate(object_id = str_remove(filename, ".png")) %>% 
  relocate(object_id) %>% 
  select(-c(directory, filename, lipid_pixels_predicted, 
            lipid_major_predicted, lipid_minor_predicted, lipidfullness1)) %>% 
  
  # The classification probability
  mutate(classprob = if_else(predLipidSac == "cant segment",
                             prob_0, prob_1)) %>% 
  select(object_id, prosome = prosome_pixels_predicted,
         lipid = lipidpcrop_pixels_predicted,
         lipidfullness = lipidfullness2,
         prosomeMajor = prosome_major_predicted,
         prosomeMinor = prosome_minor_predicted,
         lipidMajor = lipidpcrop_major_predicted,
         type = predLipidSac,
         classprob)


dups <- amund2024_samples %>% 
  group_by(object_id) %>% 
  filter(n()>1)
```

## Volumes from Ecopart
```{r}
# Organize the stations for Leg 2 and 5 from Ecopart data
leg2 <- read.csv("C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/Laval_Postdoc/Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_amundsen2024/ecopart_amundsen2024_leg2.csv")
leg5 <- read.csv("C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/Laval_Postdoc/Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_amundsen2024/ecopart_amundsen2024_leg5.csv")

ecopart_volumes <- bind_rows(leg2, leg5) %>% 
  distinct(Profile, Depth_m, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_5m = Depth_m) %>% 
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)

maxdepths <- ecopart_volumes %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Project) %>% 
  summarise(maxdepth = max(Depth_5m),
            .groups = "drop") 

# add the 5m bin and volume to the metadata
amund2024_samples_meta <- amund2024_samples_meta %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(depth / 5)*5+2.5) %>% 
  left_join(ecopart_volumes %>% 
              select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3),
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m))
```



## Convert units
```{r}
# calculate the biovolume, dry weight, prosome and lipid mass in carbon, and lipid fullness in carbon
uvpRes <- 0.084
# Conversion factor to get total lipid mg C from total lipid mg used in Schmid et al. 2018 based on 36-carbon chain lengths in (Kattner & Graeve 1991) 
lambda <- (36*12) / (36*12 + 2*36 + 2*16)
# Conversion factor to get prosome biomass (mg C) from biovolume (mm3)
vol2massC <- mean(c(0.14373,0.1177,0.1902)) # average of 3 Calanus species in (McConville et al. (2016)

# 1L = 0.001 m3

# TODO revise and clean up for later (original scripts found in UVP6_lipiscape_analysis)
amund2024_pred_2 <- amund2024_pred %>% 
   mutate(lipid_area_mm2 = lipid * uvpRes * uvpRes,
         prosome_area_mm2 = prosome * uvpRes * uvpRes) %>% 
    # Convert pixel area to mm2
  mutate(lipid_area_mm2 = lipid * uvpRes * uvpRes,
         prosome_area_mm2 = prosome * uvpRes * uvpRes) %>% 
  
  # Calculate minor axis based on prosome/lipid area and major axis
  mutate(minor_derived = (prosome / (pi * prosomeMajor/2)) * 2) %>% 
  mutate(minor_lipid_derived = (lipid / (pi * lipidMajor/2)) * 2) %>% 
  
  
  # Calculate biovolume of prosome approximated as spheroid
  mutate(prosome_biovolume_mm3 = 4/3 * pi * (prosomeMajor/2 * uvpRes) * ((minor_derived/2 * uvpRes)^2)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate lipid sac volume based on Tarling et al. (2022) eq1 derived from Miller et al. (1998) note that this is  based on cyclindrical volume approximation.. according to Miller et al. (1998) the oblate spheroid volume approximation is less accurate
  mutate(lipid_volume_mm3 = 
           (pi * lipid_area_mm2 ^ 2)/(4 * lipidMajor * uvpRes)) %>% 
  
  # # Calculate lipid sac volume based spheroid (results in slightly larger volume)
  # mutate(lipid_volume_mm3_sph = 
  #          4/3 * pi * (lipidMajor/2 * uvpRes) * ((minor_lipid_derived/2 * uvpRes)^2))

  
  # Calculate lipid fullness based on volume
  mutate(lipidfullness_volume  = (lipid_volume_mm3/prosome_biovolume_mm3 * 100)) %>% 
  
  # (Calculate lipid carbon based on area following Vogedes et al. 2010 with coefficients for 3 Arctic Calanus species
  mutate(totallipid_mass_mg = 0.197 * (lipid_area_mm2 ^ 1.38)) %>%  
  mutate(waxester_mass_mg = 0.167 * (lipid_area_mm2 ^ 1.42)) %>%  
  
  # Calculate lipid carbon mass
  mutate(lipid_mass_mgC = totallipid_mass_mg * lambda) %>%  
  mutate(waxester_mass_mgC = waxester_mass_mg * lambda) %>%  
  
  
  # TODO CLARIFY Calculate prosome carbon weight (** NOTE: many options ***)

  # Option 1: Use prosome length to volume (mm3) and calculate dry weight and mg C (Jonasdottir et al. 2019 for C. finmarchicus)
  mutate(prosome_volume_Jonasdottir = 
           0.0292 * (prosomeMajor * uvpRes)^3.6699,
         prosome_dryweight_Jonasdottir = 
           0.0106 * (prosomeMajor * uvpRes)^3.64,
         prosome_mgC_Jonasdottir = 
           0.623 * prosome_dryweight_Jonasdottir - 0.0143) %>% 
  
    # Option 2: Direct biovolume --> carbon mass based on conversion factors in McConville et al. 2016 assuming 1 mm3 = 1 mg wet weight
  mutate(prosome_mgC_McConville = 
           prosome_biovolume_mm3 * vol2massC) %>% 
  
  
  # Option 3: Lucie's coefficient for conversion is 0.9 (20% wet weight, 45% carbon in dry weight). Not that this is calculated from area and not volume
  mutate(structural_carbon = (prosome_biovolume_mm3 - lipid_volume_mm3) * 0.2 * 0.45) %>%  # Ikeda et al., 1989
  mutate(prosome_mgC_Bourreau = structural_carbon + waxester_mass_mgC) %>% 
# ** Note that wax ester mass is used here but Lucie's code seems to use lipid area/volume and multiplied with 0.79 Tarling et al. (2022) coefficient
  
  
  # Calculate lipid fullness as % carbon
  mutate(
    LF_carbon_Jonasdottir = waxester_mass_mgC / prosome_mgC_Jonasdottir * 100,
    LF_carbon_McConville = waxester_mass_mgC / prosome_mgC_McConville * 100,
    LF_carbon_Bourreau = waxester_mass_mgC / prosome_mgC_Bourreau * 100)


# The final variables to use
cope_carbon_2024 <- amund2024_pred_2 %>% 
  mutate(major_length_mm = prosomeMajor * uvpRes,
         minor_length_mm = minor_derived * uvpRes) %>% 
  select(object_id, source = type,
         major_length_mm,
         minor_length_mm,
         prosome_biovolume_mm3,
         structural_carbon,
         waxester_carbon = waxester_mass_mgC,
         total_carbon = prosome_mgC_Bourreau,
         lf_carbon = LF_carbon_Bourreau) 
```

```{r}

   # TODO remove anomalously low structural carbon values
  filter(structural_carbon > 0.05) %>% 
  # also remove really large prosome
  filter(major_length_mm <= 13) %>% 

  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon * 1000) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = (2.3*10^-7) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * exp(0.6 * (273.65-273)/ ((8.62*10^-5)*273.65*273))  * 86400) %>% 
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day =

  mutate(source = if_else(source == "visible" | source == "not visible" |
```

# Vertical distribution of 2024 data
```{r}
# cope_carbon_2024
binsize <-  100
uvp6_ecopartBin <- ecopart_volumes %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            nbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(binsize = binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m-",depthBin+binsize,"m"))
uvp6_ecopartBin <- uvp6_ecopartBin %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(uvp6_ecopartBin$depthRange)))

cope_bin_deep <- cope_carbon_2024 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(structural_carbon)) %>% 
  left_join(amund2024_samples_meta, by = "object_id") %>% 
  # Add the total volume for the depth bin
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  select(-c(Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin,
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  

  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date),
         DOY = yday(date)) %>% 
    
  
  # Calculate the abundance and carbon density per depth bin (/m3)
  # TODO can bin by data source here too
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin, 
           lon, lat, Year, Month, DOY, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(), #
            structural_carbon = sum(structural_carbon),
            waxester_carbon = sum(waxester_carbon),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            lf_carbon_mean = mean(lf_carbon),
            lf_carbon_sd = sd(lf_carbon),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         structural_carbon_m3 = structural_carbon / volume_m3,
         waxester_carbon_m3 = waxester_carbon / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3) %>% 
  select(-c(structural_carbon, waxester_carbon,
            total_carbon)) %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m-",depthBin+binsize,"m"))
cope_bin_deep <- cope_bin_deep %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(cope_bin_deep$depthRange)))




cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = waxester_carbon_m3,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fill = "gold", alpha = 0.7) +
    # geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.6, name = "latitude") +
    coord_flip() +
    # labs(x = "", y = "Wax ester carbon (mg C m⁻³)") +
    xlab("") +
  ylab(expression("Wax ester carbon  (mg C m"^-3~")")) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    # scale_y_log10()+
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = lf_carbon_mean,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fill = "gold", alpha = 0.7) +
    # geom_hline(yintercept = 50, color = "pink") +
    # geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.6, name = "latitude") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Average lipid fullness (%total C)") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  ncol = 1
)

```



## Spatial by bin
```{r}
# Calculate abundance, total carbon biomass per depth bin 
cope_bin2 <- cope_carbon_2024 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(structural_carbon)) %>% 
  left_join(amund2024_samples_meta, by = "object_id") %>% 
  # Add the total volume for the depth bin
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  select(-c(Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin,
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # # TODO: Modify depths to visualize: 
  # # Exclude the surface 100m
  # filter(Depth_5m >= 100) %>% 
  # Consider 1000 m - 2000 m
  mutate(depthRange = if_else(depthRange == "0m - 500m",
                              "100m - 500m", depthRange)) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = if_else(depthRange == "1000m - 1500m",
                              "1000m - 2000m", depthRange)) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = if_else(depthRange == "1500m - 2000m",
                              "1000m - 2000m", depthRange)) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = if_else(depthBin == 1500, 1000, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  select(-Depth_5m) %>% 
  
  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date),
         DOY = yday(date)) %>% 
    
  # Calculate the abundance and carbon density per depth bin (/m3)
  # TODO can bin by data source here too
  group_by(depthBin, depthRange,
           lon, lat, Year, Month, DOY, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(), #
            structural_carbon = sum(structural_carbon),
            waxester_carbon = sum(waxester_carbon),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            lf_carbon_mean = mean(lf_carbon),
            lf_carbon_sd = sd(lf_carbon),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         structural_carbon_m3 = structural_carbon / volume_m3,
         waxester_carbon_m3 = waxester_carbon / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3) %>% 
  select(-c(structural_carbon, waxester_carbon,
            total_carbon)) %>% 
  droplevels()


# 100 m - 500 m, 500 m - 1000 m, 1000 m - 1900 m
df0 <- cope_bin2 %>% 
  filter(depthBin == 100) %>% 
  mutate(Year = factor(Year))

cowplot::plot_grid(
  basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = TRUE,
          limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = 10,
          legends = FALSE) +
    ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df0, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                                  shape = Year,
                                                  fill = waxester_carbon_m3),
                                  size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Wax ester carbon (mg C/m3)") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24), guide = "none") +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5)),
  
  basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = TRUE,
          limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = 10,
          legends = FALSE) +
    ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df0, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                                  shape = Year,
                                                  fill = lf_carbon_mean),
                                  size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Lipid fullness") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24), guide = "none") +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5)),
  labels = "auto"
)

```
